trigger_phrase_or_event: copy locked in package before prompt/image handoff

copy_lock.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.

The date began with one missing key
and two suspects.

By the third wrong turn,
nobody was cute anymore.

“Don’t talk to me.”

He gave her the minute.
Not the distance.

It wasn’t really the wrong turn.

They had simply missed each other
for too many ordinary days.

The plan failed.
The date didn’t.

He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.

agents.prompt_summary: Extract visual mechanics from references without copying frames, likenesses, or exact labels.
Prove every locked slide through concrete Aachu/Zuv behavior, not decorative illustration.
Define wants, hidden needs, eye-lines, hands, posture, distance, and joke-to-tenderness movement.
Plan readable text and brandmark placement independently for every request-locked native output.
Translate the selected visual system into specific final-generation and integrated-text constraints.
Select one system only after scoring copy alignment, relationship proof, visual variety, identity, aspect safety, and sendability.

why_it_wins: Slide-Led Evidence Plan wins because it keeps the visual system accountable to the selected story arc.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Rain-damp evening beside a tiny roadside chai stall. Exactly Aachu and Zuv stand under one umbrella beside their modest dark car, safely parked on the quieter service lane away from traffic, dressed for a proper date. Across the divided road, through moving cars, the intended restaurant on the next road is visibly close but inconvenient to reach. The chai stall glows immediately beside them. Aachu points toward the chai stall with her right hand while her left hand stays relaxed at her side. Zuv holds the umbrella in his right hand and lowers the phone map in his left; they exchange a small conspiratorial 'shall we?' look. This is the decision before the accidental date, not the seated payoff. No chai vendor or background people visible.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy:
He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Nonlinear callback before departure, entirely OUTSIDE the apartment in a dry corridor. Medium-wide, nearly straight-on full-body view. The fully closed door is centered; its single exterior lever handle is on the RIGHT edge beside Zuv. The halfway-closing elevator and glowing call button are on frame left behind Aachu. Exactly two people stand on one depth plane, almost equal in apparent height, Zuv only slightly taller. Aachu stands on the door's left half and Zuv immediately beside its handle on the right, with one forearm of empty space between their torsos: no touch, lean, hug, waist hold, or overlap. Both lower bodies still aim left toward the elevator while their upper bodies turn back to the door. Zuv's uncovered LEFT arm stays continuous from shoulder to five visible fingers wrapped around the exterior lever; the lever angles down under clear pulling/testing tension. His RIGHT arm and hand remain hidden behind his own back, never crossed or pocketed. Aachu visibly pivots back from the elevator to the door: her left foot points to the elevator, her lifted right heel steps back to the apartment, and three tiny fading graphite motion ticks show that return path from elevator threshold to heel. Her visible RIGHT palm presses the closed center-left door panel, well away from Zuv's handle hand; that arm stays continuously readable. Her left hand stays hidden by the tote on her shoulder and tightly rolled dry umbrella under her arm. Zuv looks at his handle grip and Aachu looks at her palm contact; neither looks at the other or viewer. Both smile slightly. Aachu: real soft oval face, mostly straight long dark hair, white shirt, blue jeans, red flats. Zuv: real broader face, swept wavy quiff not ringlets, trimmed beard, light blue shirt, loose grey trousers, red-black shoes. Clothes, shoes, umbrella, hair, and floor are pristine and dry. Both visibly participate in the same closed-door check through two separate simultaneous contacts: he flexes the handle and she presses the panel after going back. No visible key or fob, interior, open door, post-date return, rain marks, folded or pocketed Zuv arms, untouched handle, solo checker, mutual glamour gaze, arrows, labels, ghost bodies, scooter, motorbike, or helmets.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.
